name: Blinq
description:
Interact with Blinq via Claude. The AI contacts app for people who meet people.

Leverage Blinq's powerful contacts and notetaking features within Claude to act on your relationships.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Blinq to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Blinq to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.blinq.me/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Blinq MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Blinq provides these MCP tools: get_contact, get_note, list_contacts, list_notes, list_workspaces, query_notes, search_notes, and whoami.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Blinq?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Blinq in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.
Blinq requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Blinq is developed by Blinq Technologies Pty Ltd. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
